subject: Transportation Systems
title: Electric Ferries and Ships
description: A quick, practical guide to Electric Ferries and Ships.

hook.text: Norway runs fully electric ferries across its fjords. Zero emissions, zero engine noise.

buildup.text: Short-distance ferries are ideal for batteries. They cross, charge at the dock, and cross again.

discovery.text: The MF Ampere, launched in 2015, was the world's first all-electric car ferry. It cut fuel costs by 80%.

twist.text: Long-distance shipping can't go battery-electric. Container ships need energy densities batteries can't deliver.

climax.text: Hydrogen, ammonia, and wind-assist are being tested for ocean shipping. No clear winner has emerged.

punchline.text: Electric ferries work today. Electric cargo ships remain a dream.

quiz.question: Why are short-distance ferries well suited to battery power?
options: Short crossings allow dock charging between trips
